child.say: Accha, number line... 2/5 ke liye, matlab paanch mein se do hisse. To do gaps aage jaana padega, na? Haan, do gaps! Shekhar ko bhi maine kal ye bataya tha, par woh to bas cricket khelne ki baat kar raha tha...

turns.teacher: Riya, aapne sahi socha: 0 se 1 ko 5 equal gaps mein baantkar, 0 se 2 gaps aage 2/5 milta hai. Bye, aapka din achchha rahe!

end.summary:
Practised equal parts using pizza as an example.
Discussed locating 2/5 on a number line.
Riya said 2/5 means two parts out of five.
Teach-back was not yet passed; no later correction was recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised fractions as equal parts and connected 2/5 with moving two gaps from zero on a number line. Riya used the phrase “two parts out of five”; the number-line explanation still needs another check. At home, ask them to mark 1/5, 2/5, and 3/5 on a line divided into five equal gaps.
